decision_source: explicit owner responses to the three immediate P8 gates named in 0139/0140/0141/0143 and the DeepSeek remainder prompt

decisions.question: Permit P8 implementation independently while Packet7 remains open, or preserve the original ordering (0100: P8 reached only after P5-7 close).
decisions.detail: P8 implementation is NOT authorized ahead of Packet7. Packet8 begins only after Packets 5-7 close. Packet7 remains blocked on the missing F3/replay-ops interfaces recorded in 0137; no locally decidable P7 runtime slice was identified.
decisions.effect: P8 implementation remains blocked. The approved migration and issuer decisions below are recorded now and become executable only once Packet7 closes.

decisions.question: Approve migration of the capture-capable HistoricalStudyVerifier constructor away from authority-only plus six arbitrary nonempty plan dictionaries with admission.consumed=True.
decisions.detail: Capture-capable HistoricalStudyVerifier construction must require authenticated owner composition and an immutable authority-verified admission identity; the current successful authority-only plus six placeholder dicts route supplies neither a trusted durable store nor a verified stable admission identity. No successful non-durable fallback remains; leaving one would keep R23 open for the old capture route.
decisions.effect: Inherits the design contract in 0138/0140/0142: remove the public _spend constructor-kwdefault authority; explicit inputs captures, admission_ref, consumer_run_identity, process_measurement_sha256, runtime_sha256, transition_nonces; inspect_capture_admission is read-only metadata validation on the existing authority, not a new grant.

decisions.question: Name/approve the trusted bootstrap issuer and its authenticated binding of admission, capture authority and durable namespace.
decisions.detail: The existing issued CapturedAuthorizationAuthority supplies the verified admission identity; the durable namespace comes from the owner-configured stable ServeRoot/genesis, never a caller-passed ledger. No new dedicated bootstrap issuer class. A public constructor accepting an arbitrary JsonlLedger would let a caller replay the same admission against a fresh empty ledger; pins, opaque wrappers, or another public factory accepting arbitrary ledgers merely relocate that bypass and remain rejected.
decisions.effect: Bare ledger injection stays rejected. When P8 becomes implementable, the trusted namespace must be authenticated owner-provided configuration, and reopening happens only through that owner against the same namespace.

resulting_state.packet7: blocked on missing F3/replay-ops interfaces (0137). No locally decidable runtime slice; do not fabricate or start unrelated F3 implementation without authorization.
resulting_state.packet8: blocked by keep-original-ordering sequencing; migration and issuer architecture now approved and frozen for use once P7 closes.
resulting_state.f5a_r23: open until P8 GREEN proof and two final lenses.

next_action: Wait for replay-ops/F3 to supply the resolved ReplayRun/NodeSpec contract, verified PUBLISHED manifest/data identities, parent manifest-producer CAPTURED receipt, and members/policy/count/order verification interfaces, then close Packet7; only then may P8 implementation proceed under the approved migration and issuer decisions with a fresh clean Phase0.
